zh: 保险箱（Vault）新增通用 API Key 与 Secret 凭据安全托管，支持独立密文加密存储、界面操作与环境解析。
完善 iOS App Store 审核与移动端体验，脱敏并优雅格式化网络异常提示，补充合规隐私政策规范与 iPad 适配支持。
增强智能体技能生态，集成家庭记账账本技能并增加本地执行降级与命令超时保护机制。
en: Introduce native API Key and Secret credential vault support with encrypted storage, management UI, and runtime injection.
Improve mobile network resilience and App Store compliance with elegant error masking, privacy policy documentation, and iPad layout support.
Enhance the agent skills ecosystem with family finance bookkeeper automation, local execution fallbacks, and command timeout protections.
